description: This Java class `LogWrapper` implements the `LogNode` interface, providing a wrapper around Android's native Log utility. It facilitates logging with additional chainable nodes, allowing logs to be forwarded to subsequent log nodes after being processed. The class primarily manages log message formatting, exception handling, and log forwarding.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility to facilitate chaining of log outputs and consistent logging behavior.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain to which log data will be forwarded.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Prints log data to Android's log system, handling message preparation, exceptions, and forwarding.
